newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: McIntosh sees A$11 mln 96/97 profit.
newsitem.headline: McIntosh sees A$11 mln 96/97 profit.

text.p: McIntosh Securities Ltd said on Friday it expected to meet its full year 1996/97 profit target of A$11 million after tax, up from A$10.1 million last year.
In its formal response to a takeover offer by New York brokerage from Merrill Lynch & Co Inc, McIntosh said activity in the Australian and New Zealand equities market was currently strong.
This was despite subdued economic activity in many sectors of the economy and disappointing profit announcements by a number of major companies.
"In this context, McIntosh is performing well in generally competitive conditions," it said.

"For the year ended 1997, McIntosh has budgeted to generate a profit of A$11 million after tax and, given current conditions, the directors of McIntosh are presently anticipating that McIntosh will achieve this target for the full year."
The McIntosh board has unanimously recommended the Merrill Lynch A$1.40 a share bid, which values the company at about A$117 million.
